{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Drop rows with invalid revenue values
sales_df = sales_df.dropna(subset=['revenue'])

# Ensure only completed orders are considered for conversion
sales_df = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'completed']

# Check the distribution of channels
channel_counts = sales_df['channel'].value_counts()
print('Channel counts:\n', channel_counts)

# Check the conversion rates for each channel
conversion_rates = sales_df.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()
print('\nConversion rates by channel:\n', conversion_rates)

# Compute the difference in conversion rates (email - paid_search)
diff_rate = conversion_rates['email'] - conversion_rates['paid_search']
print('\nDifference in conversion rates (email - paid_search):', diff_rate)"}
